name: Ahaziah
bio: Ahaziah, son of Jehoram, became king of Judah at twenty-two and reigned one year in Jerusalem; his mother was Athaliah, daughter of Omri, king of Israel. He walked in the evil ways of Ahab's house, to which he was related by marriage (2 Kings 8:24-27). He joined Jehoram (Joram) king of Israel in battle against Hazael of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, where Jehoram was wounded, and went down to Jezreel to visit the wounded king (2 Kings 8:28-29). His reign and sudden death are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
